verdict.line: You lose if you let him poke you from range for five levels straight; you win if you force fights the moment his Q is down or he's stuck in Hammer stance.

brief.thesis: Jayce's stance swap lets him choose range (Cannon) or a knockback/leap combo (Hammer) on a per-fight basis, while Darius has no reliable way to close distance except walking — E (Apprehend) only pulls enemies already inside 535 range, it isn't a gap closer. The 48.2% win rate over 278 games reflects a lane Jayce wins on paper early but that evens out once Darius starts landing full Hemorrhage stacks and threatening R (Noxian Guillotine).

theirWindow.what: He can poke you for free from 600 range with no way for you to answer back. Don't walk up to farm casters or contest a wave here — eat the chip damage or back off entirely.

yourWindow.when: He just used Q, cooldown is 16-8s
yourWindow.what: Shock Blast / To the Skies! is his only ranged or mobility tool and it's down for 16/14/12/10/8s. Close the gap immediately, land Decimate (Q) for the heal and stacks, and look for E (Apprehend) once he's inside 535 range.

full combo or kite online for him

start.why: Picked in 67.1% of games at a 50.9% win rate — the passive block and regen directly answer his poke autos and Shock Blast chip damage while you're stuck walking up.

boots.why: 84.7% pick rate at 49.8% win rate. His damage is entirely physical (autos, Q, E), so the flat armor and auto-attack reduction matter more than Swiftness here.

core.why: The active haste is the closest thing Darius has to a real gap closer against a champion who otherwise dictates range all lane.
Move speed while moving stacks into a slow on-hit, letting you actually catch him once he's stance-locked into a trade.
Bleed-over-time damage reduction and healing keeps you alive through his poke phase so you survive to the levels where you're favored.

situational.when: he's building full magic pen or you're taking repeated unanswered Shock Blast poke
you're ahead and need to survive his Hammer-stance all-in without dying to the knockback-into-follow-up
you need more raw mobility to force fights before he can reset to Cannon stance and disengage

runes.keystoneWhy: 55.2% win rate over the Stormraider's page. Conqueror's stacking adaptive damage and healing reward you for grinding through his poke to force the extended trade, which is exactly the fight you need since you can't burst him from range.

summoners.why: Flash+Ghost is run in 64.9% of games at 51.1% win rate — Ghost is the only summoner-level answer to a champion who can kite you in Cannon stance and leap away. Flash+Ignite (41.9% win rate, 17.7% pick) is the alternative if you're confident in forcing an all-in before level 6.

playing.title: Don't facecheck Cannon stance
playing.detail: Shock Blast has 600 range and hits anything in its path. If he's in Cannon stance with Q up, hold position behind minions instead of stepping forward to trade.

playing.title: Punish his Q cooldown, not his auto range
playing.detail: His real cooldown window is 16/14/12/10/8s on Q. The moment he fires it, that's your signal to close the distance and commit to a trade.

playing.title: Save E for when he's already close
playing.detail: Apprehend pulls enemies within 535 range to you — it doesn't dash you to him. Don't waste it trying to initiate from max range; use it to finish a trade he's already walked into.

playing.title: Build Hemorrhage before you commit R
playing.detail: Noxian Guillotine's true damage scales with stacks on the target. Land Q (Decimate) and an auto first so R is an execute, not just a leap-in.

playing.title: Force fights when he's stuck in Hammer stance
playing.detail: Hammer stance is his melee/engage form — if he's swapped into it to use To the Skies! or the knockback, he's committed to being in range. Take the fight then, not when he's free to swap back to Cannon.

playing.title: Walk up during minion waves, not between them
playing.detail: Use caster minions as cover to close distance incrementally instead of one long walk-up that eats a full Shock Blast in the open.

playing.title: Respect level 3-5, play for level 6+
playing.detail: This is the stretch where his combo or kite potential is highest and yours is lowest. Trade passively, hit CS, and look to flip the lane once R is up.

brief.patchCaveat: The build, runes, boots, and summoner spells above are pulled directly from measured games on the current patch (16.20.1) via OP.GG — Youmuu's into Dead Man's Plate into Death's Dance, Plated Steelcaps, Conqueror, and Flash+Ghost are the actual highest-performing picks, not guesses. The timing windows, stance-swap reads, and trade patterns are my own tactical interpretation of the ability text, not measured data.

stats.opponentTip: Maintain your distance from Jayce before reaching level 3 to avoid being punished. Try to close in when his Phase Rush is on cooldown to nuke him in one burst.
